query: Who is the U.S. representative for New York's 12th congressional district?

results.title: New York's 12th congressional district - Wikipedia
results.content:
House district for New York
Interactive map of district boundaries since January 3, 2023
As of 2023, it is represented by Democrat Jerry Nadler, redistricted incumbent of the former 10th congressional district, who defeated incumbent Carolyn Maloney in the 2022 Democratic primary.
The 12th district is located entirely in the New York City borough of Manhattan.

results.content:
Nadler is a graduate of Crown Heights Yeshiva, Stuyvesant High School, Columbia University, and Fordham Law School.
He lives on the Upper West Side of Manhattan with his wife, Joyce Miller.
He currently serves on the House Judiciary Committee and the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee and is the Dean of the New York Delegation.
Congressman Nadler served as the Chairman of the House Judiciary Committee from 2019 to 2023.
